title: The tangent projection v ↦ P̂(v) of a C² immersion is C¹
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, V ⊆ ℝ^d open, and ψ : ℝ^d → ℝ^P C² on V with Dψ(v) injective for every v ∈ V. For v ∈ ℝ^d let P̂(v) ∈ L(ℝ^P, ℝ^P) be the orthogonal projection of ℝ^P onto the subspace range Dψ(v), where Dψ(v) = fderiv ℝ ψ v (Lean: (fderiv ℝ ψ v).range.starProjection). Then v ↦ P̂(v) is C¹ on V.
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid d)) (ψ : Euclid d → Euclid P), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V → (∀ z ∈ V, Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ z)) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun v => (fderiv ℝ ψ v).range.starProjection) V
